milestone: M5.2 incoming row state, checkpoints and application wire projection

inheritance.resolver: Inherit every original symbol, option, dynamic path and unclosed owner obligation through the immutable M5.1 evidence and original audit. This selected state delta neither replaces prior ledgers nor reruns or recertifies historical runtime.

public_delta.note: Reuse createRows preparation, immutable JSON values, revision/disposal guards, existing replace/append events and full retained Map ordering. Ordinary clean loaders never infer rowStatus/status/value business properties.

checkpoint.outcome: Preserve the received immutable value and canonical status as a private checkpoint. Imported updates stay pending after local edits return to the received value. Imported inserts reset to their received value while present; ordinary add/copy inserts still cancel on revert. Imported deletes remain deleted after revert. Unchanged checkpoints preserve snapshots/caches and notify changed:false. Public original() remains undefined for every insert; deletion changes keep checkpoint-valued payloads while get() retains committed deletion display.
checkpoint.remaining: No earlier server original or pre-receive field history is invented. General data-value/schema equivalence remains required.

state_load.outcome: Receive explicit plain own value/status descriptors with exactly those keys and one of clean/insert/update/delete. Prepare every descriptor and JSON value before committing IDs/order/caches/events. Reject malformed late records, sparse arrays, imported IDs and extra own protocol keys. Preserve reentrant inner effects while rejecting stale outer preparation or disposal. Reuse clean-loader preparation and post-commit subscriber delivery.
state_load.remaining: No automatic legacy flag inference, imported identity, status registry or generic metadata adapter is provided.

anchors.outcome: Permit existing retained delete rows as add/move/copy before anchors while keeping move/copy sources live. Preserve full raw Map order, snapshots and successor no-op caches. First-position application recipes use the first retained entry, including leading/all-deleted states.
anchors.remaining: This does not introduce a second ordering engine or close unrelated Grid reorder/drag workflows.

app_wire.outcome: Application code removes the legacy rowStatus key, explicitly maps allowed statuses and projects only business keys plus protocol status. Modern deletion projection uses change.value; an explicit legacy current-value recipe uses rows.get(change.id).value. Scalar/array choice, method, standard query encoding, response decode and cancellation remain explicit through the existing communicator.
app_wire.remaining: Rows does not own HTTP policy, rowStatus parsing, automatic payload conversion or RowId transmission. Remaining transport/CVC contracts stay required.

shared_ui.outcome: Exercise received statuses and checkpoint reversion through the existing Form/Grid/List/Tree replace/append subscriptions. Preserve existing row identities and UI state on append; reset old identities/drafts on replacement; retain loaded tombstone editing guards and authored accessibility cleanup.
shared_ui.remaining: List editing, general Tree validation, Form choice/render mapping and remaining UI workflows stay open.

demo.outcome: Expose authored controls for incoming state, checkpoint edits/reversion and retained ordering in the existing Grid demo. Keep controller/CVC ownership, shared Rows, application rule/wire functions and authored HTML/CSS; add no second demo framework.
demo.remaining: The demo is selected acceptance coverage, not completion of every legacy UI/CVC behavior.

installed.outcome: Install one exact package in isolated JavaScript and TypeScript consumers and exercise the same artifact in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, actual Windows Chrome and Edge. Cover explicit state entry points, checkpoint/cancellation distinction, retained anchors and immutable/shared values.
installed.remaining: No npm publication or release tag. Actual macOS/iOS Safari remains excluded; available WebKit is mandatory.

All 60 medians recompute from 300 raw durations. Original nine binding and twenty-one viewport budgets pass, with 105 live checkpoints, 300 scroll windows, fifteen append and exact quiet-disposal samples, and bounded physical-row maxima 14/14/24.
Six inherited evidence parents, original Grid counts, v1 files and the ignored legacy lock remain unchanged. No historical runtime is rerun or recertified.
